visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Picture makes the page scroll sideways
visualizerParams.problemDescription: On a phone this wide picture runs past the edge of the screen and the whole page scrolls sideways. The picture has no limit on its width.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
<style>
  svg { height: auto; }
</style>
<svg viewBox="0 0 900 300" width="900" height="300">
  <rect width="900" height="300" fill="orange"/>
</svg>

solution.code:
<style>
  svg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
</style>
<svg viewBox="0 0 900 300" width="900" height="300">
  <rect width="900" height="300" fill="orange"/>
</svg>
solution.explanation: The picture has its own width (900px here). max-width: 100% limits it to the width of its container, and height: auto then scales the height so the picture is not stretched.

checks.label: The page does not scroll sideways
